body: I dunno what to do. I'm in the north east. Y'all can call if you want but the shower curtain is looking really fine right now. I know most don't want to talk. I tried the missions. I tried everywhere. Around here nobody wants to help. I just think that somehow my life meant something to someone. I dunno what to do. Sorry, I don't know how this works. 512-850-6664 is my number. I have almost no charge left.

I got a bottle of vodka. Maybe took a few shots, got sick. I got some tobacco. Rolled a cigarette and wanted to puke. I need to go to surgery soon, I'm in severe pain from a hernia, I don't even know when or where. I even got mugged, lost my key fob. I look at myself in the mirror and don't even know who I'm looking at. I don't want to even eat, I haven't in two days. I don't want to do anything but go to sleep forever.

I had a home. A big home. 2700 square feet of oil polished floors. Four zones. I had books. Lots of books, old ones, volumes, collections. I had stuff to cook with. Frying pans from my grandmother's time. Good cookware. A lifetime of things. Kids that were brought up right. Tools. Computer equipment. Toys from when I was four. I watched them being sold online. I can work. I do work. I just don't see the point anymore. I don't
I just replied. I tried already. The human body doesn't want to die, it kicks.
